dedupe_keys.name: convlstm based daily water table depth wtd predictions over europe

description: The STARS4Water team deposits daily water-table-depth estimates from a ConvLSTM model over Europe. Its page describes a 0.11-degree grid and a comparison against TSMP simulations. Two public NetCDFs are labelled for ERA5-Land and TSMP driving conditions, each several gigabytes. The description says 2010 to 2019, but the TSMP file inventory ends in 2018, so a common comparison period cannot be assumed without opening the files. Zenodo labels the deposit CC BY 4.0. A continental groundwater or drought simulation could compare broad patterns of water-table response under alternative drivers. These are simulated estimates, not well measurements, and the own page does not state depth units, datum, cell masking or error statistics. Neither NetCDF was downloaded; their variables and actual date coordinates remain unverified. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this European grid release.
name: ConvLSTM-based Daily Water Table Depth (WTD) Predictions over Europe
notes: G6 item G6-2327. Metadata-only draft. Simulation-use and type tags are reviewer classifications. File contents and software execution were not checked. Unknown maturity does not assert active maintenance.
